exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute
sale, selling (exchange of goods or services for currency or credit)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́дать — to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; преда́ние — handing over, committing; да́нный — given, present, this; прода́жа — sale, selling (exchange of goods or services for currency or credit).
**выдал** — вы́дать (perfective): to give out, to pay out, to hand, to issue, to distribute; to produce; to deliver up, to give up, to extradite; to betray, to give away. Wiktionary: вы- + дать.
